questions.question: A researcher claims that adding street lighting reduced nighttime pedestrian injuries. Which finding would most weaken the claim?
options: The new lamps used less electricity than older lamps.
Residents preferred the color of the new lights.
Injury rates fell by the same amount on nearby unlit streets after a citywide speed limit was lowered.
The installation occurred during the summer.
questions.explanation: C is correct. A comparable decline without lighting points to the speed-limit change as an alternative explanation.
questions.teachingTopic: 选择最能支持或削弱某项结论的文本证据

questions.question: A teacher claims that weekly practice discussions improved students' ability to explain scientific evidence. Which result would most directly support the claim?
options: Discussion students used pencils of several colors.
The class read three different scientific topics.
Some students preferred working alone.
Students assigned to weekly discussions improved more on a common explanation task than students with the same reading assignments but no discussions.
questions.explanation: D is correct. The controlled comparison isolates the discussion practice and measures the claimed skill.
